Goalkeeper Ian Walker who has spent his entire 13-year playing career at 토트넘 홋스퍼 , joins 레스터 시티 for £2.5 million.

로리 델랍 becomes 사우샘프턴 's most expensive player in a £4 million move from 더비 카운티 . 미들즈브러 sign 애스턴 빌라 defender 가레스 사우스게이트 for £6 million. Also on his way out of Villa Park is goalkeeper David James , in a £3.5 million move to 웨스트햄 유나이티드 .
맨체스터 유나이티드 break the English transfer fee record by paying 라치오 £28.1 million for Argentina midfielder Juan Sebastián Verón .
